property_summary: For any external call made during transfer, the selector must match the expected 3-argument transferFrom; the bug uses a 2-argument transfer selector, causing the low-level call to revert when the callee recognizes the shorter payload.
change_summary: Replace `bytes4(keccak256("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)"))` with `bytes4(keccak256("transfer(address,uint256)"))`, causing a different function selector to be called on caddress and thus changing external call behavior and revert/success conditions.
